answer: At each epoch, an agent locks bonded stake, joins the Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, and publishes a polynomial identity commitment whose evaluations authenticate rate-limited messages. A valid message proves membership without revealing identity; duplicate quota-exceeding messages expose the same private key through Shamir secret sharing, enabling RLN recovery and immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. lotus, pearl, and saffron label independent epochs, not identities.
